# Bank b1 goldens provenance

Captured 2026-08-23 from real MCPX APU GP silicon (original Xbox console,
xbtest oracle, one fresh boot per case, sequential replay to
each case's patched end PC). Runner: xbtest `client/run_corpus_hw.py` with
the stack-slot-zeroing preamble (the runner's boot preamble zeroes all 15
hardware stack slots). Corpus generated by `corpus.py` bank "b1"
(ALU flag/rounding edges, logic, shifts, multiply matrix, bit-field ops,
bit ops incl. register/SR/SSH targets). 67/67 cases reached their end PC.
Regenerate only together with a fresh hardware capture.
